sentences: I want you to always end your method names with '_ud'.
Additionally, I want you to start your variable names with 'w_'.
So, if you have a variable that stores the total number of calculations, you would name it 'w_total_calculations'.
Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.
Remember, consistency and clarity in your code are important.
These conventions will help ensure that your code is easy to read and maintain.
Now, regarding the development, I think we should keep it agile and iterative.
We can start with the core functionality and then improve and add features based on user feedback.
Going forward, I want you to include a single digit in your variable names.
